register_optimizer_components: register AdamW and Adafactor optimizer components into a fairseq2 DependencyContainer
create_optimizer_from_factory: create an Optimizer instance by resolving the _OptimizerFactory from the dependency resolver
create_adamw_optimizer: create an AdamW optimizer using an AdamWConfig and the _AdamWFactory
create_adafactor_optimizer: create an Adafactor optimizer using an AdafactorConfig and the _AdafactorFactory
review_register_optim: review the _register_optim function to understand how optimizer factories are wired into the DI container
